checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same hatchback, same position, unchanged details
must.why: Car matches in shape, position, wheels, lights; the plate is slightly changed but is the same plate.
Houses, trees, pole and cars are in the same places.

faults.what: The car's red paint converted to a fairly flat mid-grey, so the car looks dull compared with the original. This is a normal result of desaturation, not an edit fault.

summary: A faithful, uncropped black-and-white version of the photo with nothing else changed.
